lines.C01: [startled, then annoyed] Oops, the ceiling. {{pause=0.3}} [satisfied] There. {{pause=0.4}} [smug, drawling] Welcome to Versailles. [delighted, self-admiring] Yes, I'm that handsome. {{pause=0.4}} [sneering, amused] Try not to faint.
lines.C02: [conspiratorial, proud] A hundred people watch me wake up. {{pause=0.6}} [smug, savouring] I call it... {{pause=0.3}} opening night.
lines.C03: [dry, bored] The doctor. {{pause=0.2}} The surgeon. {{pause=0.3}} Nobody came to see them. {{pause=0.7}} [smug, pleased] Everyone came for me. {{pause=0.4}} [soft, satisfied] Naturally.
lines.C04: [brisk] Now, the wig. {{pause=0.4}} [mock-tragic, a small sigh] My hair started falling out at seventeen. {{pause=0.7}} [wounded pride] I took it personally.
lines.C05: [smug] They say it makes me taller. {{pause=0.7}} [lofty] I never look down. {{pause=0.4}} [sighs contentedly]
lines.C06: [theatrical, savouring] White, grey, a little powder. {{pause=0.4}} [prophetic, grandly] One day, everybody will wear this. {{pause=0.4}} [mock-modest, chuckles] I'm just early.
lines.C07: [regal, bored] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.4}} [delighted, preening] Yes, this is the new wig. {{pause=0.3}} [arrogant] Take notes.
lines.C08: [contemptuous] All these people, and nobody may speak before me. {{pause=0.5}} [tender, adoring] I love listening. {{pause=0.3}} [snorts a laugh] To myself, mostly.
lines.C09: [sharp, scandalised] Lower. {{pause=0.3}} Lower... {{pause=0.3}} [deadpan] and there goes the hat. {{pause=0.4}} [recovering haughtiness] Eyes on me, not on the hat.
lines.C10: [flirtatious, teasing] Red heels. Nobles only, {{pause=0.3}} [smug] and only the ones I like. {{pause=0.4}} [proud] Mine are the tallest, of course.
lines.C12: [sly, confiding] Venice kept the secret. {{pause=0.6}} So we... borrowed their glassmakers. {{pause=0.8}} [glancing at the mirrors, pleased] Now every wall looks at me. [laughs softly at himself]
lines.C13: [snapping, irritated] Mon Dieu, don't stand behind me, you're spoiling my reflection. {{pause=0.5}} [imperious, waving him off] Go. {{pause=0.2}} Over there. {{pause=0.2}} Further.

lines.C15: [polite, lofty] Now, if you'll excuse me... {{pause=0.4}} [gleeful, hungry] the soup is getting cold. [a cold, haughty laugh]
lines.C09b: [sharp, scandalised] Lower! {{pause=0.45}} [snapping] Lower! {{pause=1.4}} [deadpan, slow] And there goes... {{pause=0.2}} the... [drawn out] haaat. {{pause=1.3}} [slow, haughty, drawling] Eyes on... me, {{pause=0.1}} not on the hat. {{pause=2.0}}
lines.C09c: [sharp, scandalised] Lower! {{pause=0.45}} [snapping] Lower! {{pause=1.4}} [deadpan, very slow] And there goes the... hat. {{pause=1.3}} [haughty, slowly] Eyes on me, not on the hat.
